subject: Post-demo privacy follow-up: PII sanitization and tuning-block confirmation (Medisys)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Claire Ng <claire@medisys.com>, Ben Porter <ben.porter@medisys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 14:15:00 +0200
Subject: Post-demo privacy follow-up: PII sanitization and tuning-block confirmation (Medisys)

Hi Claire / Ben —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap and the asks I promised to put in writing so your InfoSec and procurement teams have what they need. I captured the points we discussed and added concrete next steps below.

Summary (what Medisys asked for)
- Explicit written confirmation that Redwood will not use Medisys data to fine-tune or improve any models (no training on customer data).
- PII handling: customer-side redaction plus Redwood will apply additional automated PII detection/sanitization steps for logs forwarded to us.
- Logging/retention: preferred retention window is 90 days for auditability; Redwood standard is 30 days. Please confirm if 90 is a firm requirement.
- Data residency: EU-only (Ireland region) for model execution, logs, and backups.
- Security evidence: SOC 2, encryption in transit & at rest, and KMS key isolation.

What Redwood can confirm now
- We will disable any telemetry aggregation and model-improvement pipelines for your tenant unless you explicitly opt in. This means: no fine-tuning, no inclusion in training corpora, and we will not use prompts/outputs for model updates.
- PII handling: we will apply an automated redaction layer to logs received by the platform and additionally honor any client-supplied sanitization before ingestion. We will share the detection ruleset summary with your team.
- Residency: we can pin your workload to our EU (Ireland) region and ensure logs are stored on EU-only storage with EU KMS keys.
- Retention: our default (no-cost) retention is 30 days. We can extend to 90 days as a configurable option; longer retention may have price/contract implications.

Attachments: Redwood-Security-Overview.pdf (application/pdf) — high-level controls
SOW-Draft-Medisys.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document) — draft for POC and DPA addendum

Suggested next steps
1) I will send a short written attestation (below) that we can include in the DPA/MSA.
2) If 90 days is required, confirm and I will route to Contracts for an amendment and estimate for the delta.
3) I'll open a DocuSign package for the DPA + SOW draft so your legal can start review.

Short attestation (for InfoSec checklist) — draft
"Redwood Inference confirms that it will not use Medisys Health customer data for model training, fine-tuning, or model evaluation unless explicitly authorized in writing by Medisys. Medisys data will be excluded from any aggregate training datasets. Logs and telemetry will be stored in the EU region and encrypted at rest and in transit. Retention policy will be applied per the agreed contract."

If that aligns, I'll push the SOW + DPA to DocuSign this afternoon.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0176
E: tessa.morgan@redwood.com

From: Claire Ng <claire@medisys.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Porter <ben.porter@medisys.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 14:38:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Post-demo privacy follow-up: PII sanitization and tuning-block confirmation (Medisys)

Tessa — thanks for the clear recap. A couple of clarifications from our side before we route to InfoSec: 

1) The attestation language looks good but we need an explicit statement that neither prompts nor generated outputs will be retained for model improvements. Can you add that line?
2) Retention: 90 days is our baseline for audit; we agreed to 90 during the call. Please confirm if Redwood can commit to 90 days in the DPA.
3) Data deletion SLA: we need confirmation of a deletion timeline after contract termination (30 days after termination for all customer-produced data and logs).
4) Encryption: confirm AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit, and that EU keys are customer-separately-managed (bring-your-own-key via KMS).

If you can send the revised attestation + DPA/SOW we will start the InfoSec intake. Ben will manage procurement/PO side.

Best,
Claire Ng
Director of Platform Engineering | Medisys Health

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Claire Ng <claire@medisys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Porter <ben.porter@medisys.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 14:55:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Post-demo privacy follow-up: PII sanitization and tuning-block confirmation (Medisys)

Claire — really appreciate the precision. I updated the attestation text below and captured the specific tech confirmations. If that looks good, we'll fold into the DPA and SOW and route to DocuSign.

Updated attestation (to include prompts/outputs retention)
"Redwood Inference confirms that it will not use Medisys Health customer data for model training, fine-tuning, or model evaluation unless explicitly authorized in writing by Medisys. This exclusion includes customer prompts, generated outputs, and any metadata associated with customer requests; none of these items will be retained or used for model improvement pipelines without explicit written opt-in from Medisys. Medisys data will be excluded from aggregate training datasets. Logs and telemetry will be stored in the EU region and encrypted at rest and in transit. Retention policy will be applied per the agreed contract."

Technical confirmations
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest; TLS 1.3 in transit.
- KMS: EU-based keys; option for customer-managed keys (BYOK) for the EU tenant.
- Residency: Workloads and logs pinned to our Ireland (eu-west-1 equivalent) region.
- Retention: We can support a 90-day retention window for logs as requested. Our standard deletion SLA after contract termination is 30 days; we can put a contractual commitment to 30 days for full data purge.
- Evidence: attaching Redwood-Security-Overview.pdf (SOC 2 & controls). If InfoSec wants a deeper packet, we can schedule a tabletop or provide a gated read-only binder.

Commercial note: enabling 90-day retention + BYOK and EU-key isolation are both doable; there is a modest monthly surcharge for customer-managed keys and extended retention. I can get numbers from Ops once you confirm the desired configuration.

Next steps
- I'll attach the attestation to the DPA addendum and send the DocuSign link: https://docusign.example.com/Tx12345
- Please route to InfoSec; Ben, if you can start procurement/PO conversation, we'll include estimated delta in the SOW.

SOW and DPA draft attached: SOW-Draft-Medisys.docx; Redwood-Security-Overview.pdf

Talk soon —
Tessa
